face.name: 载蛋雏龙
face.text: 战吼：&随机获取一张法力值消耗小于或等于（3）点的龙牌。
face.flavorText: 雏龙宝宝就是这么来的……

face.name: Carrier Whelp
face.text: Battlecry:& Get a random Dragon that costs (3) or less.
face.flavorText: So that's where baby dragons come from...

face.name: 空中悍匪
face.text: 战吼：&随机将一张海盗牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 或许他应该构思一个能把战利品也一块带回来的飞行方案。

face.name: Sky Raider
face.text: Battlecry:& Add a random Pirate to your hand.
face.flavorText: Maybe he should've hatched a plan that could actually carry booty back too.

face.name: 宝石鹦鹉
face.text: 战吼：&随机将一张野兽牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 地精珠宝商慕名而来，失望而归…

face.name: Jeweled Macaw
face.text: Battlecry:& Add a random Beast to your hand.
face.flavorText: It’s not LITERALLY jeweled. The goblins were terribly disappointed.

face.name: 呓语魔橱
face.text: 战吼：&随机将2张法师法术牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 呓语魔橱现在就是我心目当中的第一卡。阳光，积极，又大方。只需三点法力值拍到场上去，他就能给你两张实用法术牌，太棒了。

face.name: Babbling Bookcase
face.text: Battlecry:& Add 2 random Mage spells to your hand.
face.flavorText: Babbling Bookcase is quickly becoming one of my favorite cards. It's just so positive and generous. Practically costs nothing at all at three mana you drop him on the board and that chill guy gives you two spells to use later in the game.

face.name: 吹嘘海盗
face.text: 战吼：&随机将一张另一职业的卡牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 只要两杯朗姆酒，他就能吹上一整天！

face.name: Swashburglar
face.text: Battlecry:& Add a random card from another class to your hand.
face.flavorText: Was almost named "Swashb-AAAARRHHH-gler"

face.name: 冬泉雏龙
face.text: 战吼：&发现一张任意职业的法力值消耗为（1）的法术牌。
face.flavorText: 学习展翅飞翔的时候，参考其他职业的经验很重要！

face.name: Winterspring Whelp
face.text: Battlecry:& Discover a 1-Cost spell from any class.
face.flavorText: It's important to explore other classes while learning to spread your wings!

face.name: 虚无行者
face.text: 战吼： 发现一张恶魔牌。
face.flavorText: 在学会虚空行走之前，先给我爬。

face.name: Netherwalker
face.text: Battlecry: Discover a Demon.
face.flavorText: You got to Nethercrawl before you can Netherwalk.

face.name: 武装教士
face.text: 战吼： 发现一张神圣法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她是那种最接地气的圣骑士……除非她站起身来。

face.name: Battle Vicar
face.text: Battlecry: Discover a Holy spell.
face.flavorText: She's the most down-to-earth paladin you'll ever meet... until she stands up.

face.name: 黑市摊贩
face.text: 战吼：&发现一张法力值消耗为（1）的卡牌。
face.flavorText: 快来瞧瞧这台空气净化器，它的功能如此强大，连你的灵魂都能净化！

face.name: Dark Peddler
face.text: Battlecry:& Discover a 1-Cost card.
face.flavorText: I'm offering you a bargain here! This amazing vacuum cleaner for your soul!

face.name: 玉莲帮荷官
face.text: 亡语：&获取一张幸运币。
face.flavorText: 稍稍抽了点水。本能使然。

face.name: Lotus Bookie
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a Coin.
face.flavorText: He skims a bit from the top. It's just his nature.

face.name: 幸运币
face.text: 在本回合中，获得一个 法力水晶。
face.flavorText: 不管你是花掉它还是留在手里，总有一枚幸运币留给后手的你。

face.name: The Coin
face.text: Gain 1 Mana Crystal this turn only.
face.flavorText: Whether you spend it or save it, it's always there for a second.
